E1 succeeds only when all eight fun criteria are demonstrated in a playable Normal build, judged by you plus 2–3 fresh players, with the debug harness confirming deterministic behavior—identical inputs produce identical enemy actions. The criteria cover readable/satisfying deflection, clarity-based perfect-read dodges, meaningful Poise→击 and tap/hold mercy choices, fair Feinter teaching, natural Conscript mercy, felt qi rewards, trusted non-random behavior, and meaningful hesitation.
